response.sql: SELECT ma.player_id AS manager_id, p.death_country, COUNT(*) AS award_count, 1.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.death_country) AS share FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND p.death_country <> '' GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
